channel.title: Cyber Chronicle
channel.description: Source-linked cybersecurity news and reviewed reports.

item.title: OpenRouter Drops 3 Providers After Researchers Catch Months of Prompt Theft at AI Hosting Firms
item.description: The Hacker News reports: Attackers stole data from inside three AI inference providers for months, and none of the three knew until researchers told them, the industrial cybersecurity company Dragos said this week. Some of the stolen requests were flagged as Zero Data Retention, the setting that is supposed to mean a prompt is never stored.…

item.title: Researchers Demonstrate Ghostscript Sandbox-Escape RCE via Crafted File Uploads in Popular Apps
item.description: The Hacker News reports: A now-patched flaw in Ghostscript allows a crafted file to escape the program's security sandbox and run commands on the server that processes it. Ghostscript is the interpreter that many Linux servers use to convert uploaded PDFs, PostScript files, and images into other formats, often without the application calling it directly.…

item.title: Rackspace Spot breach let hackers access customer Kubernetes secrets
item.description: BleepingComputer reports: Rackspace warned customers that hackers breached its Rackspace Spot cloud platform using compromised credentials, allowing them to deploy unauthorized workloads and access Kubernetes secrets in customer clusters. [...]

item.title: Trump says reported FBI database hack is ‘not good’
item.description: TechCrunch reports: The FBI is reportedly investigating a hack of the National Crime Information Center.

item.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
item.description: BleepingComputer reports: Microsoft is warning organizations that it suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information. [...]

item.title: BADBOX botnet returns with record-breaking 40 billion daily ad requests
item.description: BleepingComputer reports: The BADBOX malware found in a broad range of generic Android TV boxes has returned to large-scale ad-fraud operations following last year's disruptions. [...]

item.title: FBI reportedly hacked again, this time targeting nationwide police database
item.description: BleepingComputer reports: FBI systems have reportedly been breached for the second time in two months, this time targeting the agency's National Crime Information Center (NCIC), which is used to share information between local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies. [...]

item.title: A Single Malicious Webpage Let Researchers Hijack Meta Muse and Access Private Chats
item.description: The Hacker News reports: A malicious webpage could extract a Meta Muse user's private conversations and stored memories from the assistant without triggering any approval prompt, researchers have shown. The same attack could be extended to reach the credentials Muse stores for the user's connected accounts.…

item.title: GnuPG Warns Critical GPGME Flaw Could Expose App Data via Malicious OpenPGP Keys
item.description: The Hacker News reports: A malicious OpenPGP key with an unusually long user ID can trigger a critical memory bug in GPGME, the standard library that programs use to work with GnuPG. The GnuPG project warned yesterday that the flaw could be used to steal data from affected applications and has released fixed versions.…

item.title: Attackers' AI Agents Found a Zero-Day in Medical-Imaging Software and Gained Root Access
item.description: The Hacker News reports: Suspected China-linked hackers used autonomous AI agents to find a previously unknown flaw in MONAI Label, an open-source medical imaging server, and gain root access to a university server, Amazon Threat Intelligence said this week.…

item.title: Signal Blocks AI Agents From Reading Private Chats via Screenshots on Android and iOS
item.description: The Hacker News reports: Signal has announced that it will restrict screenshots by default to stop artificial intelligence (AI) agents from reading private chats on Android and iOS devices, but conceded that the protection is "incomplete." The feature applies to agentic systems built into iOS 27 and on Android versions where the encrypted messaging platform can detect an AI…

item.title: Hackers Exploit Critical VMware, Cisco, and Apache Flaws as Espionage Attacks Emerge
item.description: The Hacker News reports: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added four flaws impacting Apache Roller, Cisco Expressway, SAP NetWeaver, and Broadcom VMware vCenter to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), citing evidence of active exploitation.…

item.title: Indian organisations report declining readiness to manage cybersecurity risks
item.description: ET CISO reports: Indian companies are witnessing enhanced returns from AI investments and expanding their use from pilot schemes. Nonetheless, their readiness to tackle external risks associated with AI appears to have worsened. Concerns about security loom large, with firms feeling inadequately prepared for potential cyberattacks.…

item.title: China's 'Armory Castle' Lays Siege to VMware vCenter Zero-Day
item.description: Dark Reading reports: During the last wave of major VMware vCenter security updates, a China-nexus threat group likely already had its next zero-day up its sleeve.

item.title: Experts warn: Nearly everyone in AI is susceptible to a honey-trap scheme right now
item.description: TechCrunch reports: Techies are building technology that can advance all aspects of the world — but can they protect their hearts? That's the vulnerability that honey pots exploit.

item.title: Bell Canada says 'agentic' hacker stole enterprise customer data
item.description: BleepingComputer reports: Bell Canada has confirmed that an "agentic" threat actor breached its systems on November 17, 2026, and stole enterprise customer data, including information from a system used to order and provision telecommunications circuits. [...]

item.title: In Security, Words Matter as Much as Tools, Maybe More
item.description: Dark Reading reports: From talking cloud security to using AI, cyber leaders are finding that clear, disciplined communication is now a front-line defense capability across the enterprise.

item.description: The Hacker News reports: Meta-owned WhatsApp has addressed security vulnerabilities, including one impacting its Android app that it suspects may have been exploited in connection with scam messages.…

item.title: Hackers use autonomous AI tool Cairn to find zero-day, take over server
item.description: BleepingComputer reports: Threat actors used the open-source AI penetration-testing framework Cairn to find a previously unknown vulnerability in a medical imaging application. [...]

item.title: What We Missed: Nvidia CEO Scandal Rocks AI Industry
item.description: Dark Reading reports: In this video, Dark Reading editors discuss some of the news they didn't get a chance to cover, from Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia to Microsoft's recent cloud outage.

item.description: The Hacker News reports: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a previously unknown Android malware framework called Bazuka that offers large language model (LLM) integration for victim management and control at scale. Dutch mobile security company ThreatFabric said it discovered the threat in late October 2026 during an investigation into an NFC-relay banking Trojan.…

item.description: BleepingComputer reports: J.P. Morgan Chase warned it suffered a data breach after a cyberattack at a third-party service provider exposed customers' personal information and marketing data. [...]

item.title: Still tracking company passwords in spreadsheets? You’re flying blind.
item.description: BleepingComputer reports: Tracking company passwords in spreadsheets can leave IT administrators unaware of weak, reused, or compromised credentials stored and shared outside approved systems. NordPass explains how centralized password management can improve credential visibility, identify security risks, and simplify secure password sharing. [...]

item.title: N-able says recent security breach led to major service outage
item.description: BleepingComputer reports: N-able says attackers who breached one of its servers have caused a major outage affecting Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud services worldwide. [...]

item.title: Linux KVM Flaw CVE-2026-99312 Lets Guest VMs Access Host Memory on AMD Hosts
item.description: The Hacker News reports: A flaw in KVM, the hypervisor built into the Linux kernel, let researchers read about 127 GB of a cloud server's memory from inside a virtual machine of their own on DigitalOcean. On a shared server, that memory can include other customers' virtual machines.…

item.title: Microsoft now automatically installs Windows 11 26H2 on unmanaged devices
item.description: BleepingComputer reports: Starting this week, Microsoft has begun automatically upgrading eligible devices that aren't managed by an IT department to Windows 11 26H2. [...]

item.title: The Path to AI Autonomy in the SOC
item.description: The Hacker News reports: Security leaders are about to hand AI agents a lot more authority. In a recent a16z survey of CISOs at organizations with more than 1,000 employees, 36% said they are comfortable today letting AI agents act autonomously on low-risk security actions. In 12 months from now, 60% expect to be comfortable at that level.…

item.description: BleepingComputer reports: US cybersecurity company F5 warned customers to patch five critical BIG-IP vulnerabilities that attackers can exploit to trigger denial-of-service (DoS) or gain remote code execution. [...]

item.title: SonicWall Warns Gen 6 Firewalls Won't Get Security Patches, Even for Critical Flaws
item.description: The Hacker News reports: SonicWall has urged all customers still running Generation 6 firewalls to retire and replace them immediately and stop exposing the devices on the internet edge, citing security risks fueled by AI-assisted attacks. "Attackers now use automation and AI to find and exploit unsupported edge devices faster than ever," SonicWall said.…

item.description: The Hacker News reports: Threat actors have been observed exploiting a recently disclosed critical security flaw in Cisco Expressway to breach a Russian organization shortly after the public release of a proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit.…

item.description: The Hacker News reports: A newly disclosed unpatched zero-day technique called FastUnlock lets someone with physical access to a locked Windows computer start programs without signing in. Whoever uses it gets only a limited account, not administrator control of the machine.…

item.title: Secure by design, even when AI writes the code: Larry Lidz
item.description: ET CISO reports: As AI coding agents take on a growing role in software development, security can no longer remain a periodic review or a final checkpoint before release. Larry Lidz, Vice President, Software Security at Cisco, discusses how agentic engineering is changing secure software development, how Cisco is adapting its long-standing Secure Development Lifecycle, and…
